notes: parseGeoJSON: features with a geometry, properties and non-empty coordinates; Polygon -> one polygon (exterior, interiors), MultiPolygon -> one per polygon with an exterior, LineString -> one linestring of one line, MultiLineString -> one of all; name = properties[nameProperty || "name"], centre = properties.cp. The compressed form (UTF8Encoding) decodes each encoded string per UTF-16 unit: c - 64, zigzag (x >> 1) ^ -(x & 1), delta from encodeOffsets, / (UTF8Scale ?? 1024).

GeoJSONResource: parsed regions are cached per nameProperty; then for a map named china fixNanhai (append the islands region unless one exists), per region fixTextCoord (centre += offset / 10.5, -offset / (10.5 / 0.75)), fixDiaoyuIsland (Taiwan gets a polygon), and a special area is transformed to its box (the missing size from the aspect). load(): nameMap renames by a shallow clone; the bounding rect is the union of the regions' rects (unprojected).

Geo: invertY (invertLongitute) unless a projection is given; aspectScale = projection ? 1 : retrieve2(option, 0.75); with a projection the rect is the union of the projected regions' rects. resizeGeo: boundingCoords (sampled through the projection: top, right, bottom and a DIAGONAL for the left edge, 101 points each), aspect = rect.width / rect.height * aspectScale, layoutCenter + layoutSize when both parse, else getLayoutRect(box + aspect) and applyPreserveAspect. View: raw = calculateTransform(dataRect (y flipped), viewRect) decomposed with scaleY negated; roam from center / zoom; overall = decompose(roam * raw) -- with a flip that leaves skewX = PI, so getLocalTransform puts tan(PI) * scaleY into m[2].

MapDraw: one group per region name; per region a CompoundPath of its polygons (exterior then interiors) and one of its lines, segmentIgnoreThreshold 1, points through the RAW matrix (projected first), the group carrying the ROAM transform. Style: itemStyle (areaColor over color), strokeNoScale; lines: stroke = stroke || fill, no fill. Label: text from getFormattedLabel (formatter string: replace the first {a}) or the name, align center / middle, textConfig.position the region centre as percentages of the path's stroked box.

cases.note: the defaults: left / top center, aspectScale 0.75, the special areas moved
itemStyle with areaColor, label shown with a template, regions overriding one region and labelling another
label.show with no formatter: the region name; itemStyle.color with no areaColor; borderType dashed
getLayoutRect with both sizes, with one size, preserveAspect contain
preserveAspect cover with left / bottom, true with right; a box wider than the map
layoutCenter + layoutSize: aspect below 1, above 1, and invalid (the box instead)
boundingCoords flipped (new BoundingRect turns a negative height round), a box, an invalid pair
aspectScale 0.5, 0 (retrieve2 keeps the zero), null (the default)
projections through handles: sinusoidal with boundingCoords (sampled, the left edge a diagonal), linear, one dropping points, one without unproject
[R2-J2] d3-geo geoAlbersUsa through the handles (map-usa-projection): the lower 48, Alaska and Hawaii in their insets, Puerto Rico in none (null: its points dropped)
[R2-J3] the same with the labels shown: Puerto Rico has no centre, so its label stays at textConfig.position inside -- the middle of its (empty) path box through the group transform
center and zoom from the option; percentages of the data rect; scaleLimit clamping the zoom
the compressed format: Macau as shipped, and read at UTF8Scale 2048

cases.note: every geometry kind encoded, a plain geometry in an encoded file, the features parseGeoJson drops
a map named china: the South China Sea islands added, Taiwan given the island, label centres moved; the same data under another name
a china map that already has the islands region: none added, its label centre still moved
nameProperty code, nameMap renaming, duplicated names sharing one group, cp, echartsStyle
show false draws nothing but keeps the coordinate system; silent; clip with a zoom
a map of lines: fixLineStyle strokes with the fill; the last tiny segment of a polyline is never flushed
a null geometry in a compressed file: decode reads its encodeOffsets and the parse throws
a map nobody registered: Geo reads regions off undefined and setOption throws
PathProxy's pending point: a tie of two folded points keeps the earlier; a line's folded end is drawn by the next sub-path's moveTo

no fill (areaColor "none"): the label rect grows by strokeContainThreshold; a line with its own borderColor keeps it through fixLineStyle; areaColor and color null leave the default fill #000 of zrender; borderWidth null its default lineWidth 1
zoom 0 (and null) is 1 before scaleLimit {max: 0.5} clamps it; preserveAspect with a box of the same aspect (to the bit) is not laid out again

guards.note: regions keep the features' order
a GeoJSON map inverts y, a projection does not
aspectScale 0.75 by default, 1 under a projection
the overall matrix carries tan(PI) * scaleY in m[2]; the raw one does not
a special area is moved to its box and its centre is the box centre
a special area with no height takes it from the aspect
geo labels exist (emphasis shows them) but are ignored in the normal state
a region label sits at z2 2 over its path at 0
formatter replaces the first {a}
only the first {a} is replaced; a $& in the template stays
a region turning its label off
areaColor fills; a region's own wins
the anchor is layoutRect.x + parseFloat(position) / 100 * width
position is a pair of percentages
the layout rect is the path box grown by the 0.5 border
segmentIgnoreThreshold 1 folds small segments
with both sizes the aspect is not applied
boundingCoords [[-180, 90], [180, -90]] is turned round
invalid boundingCoords leave the map's own rect
aspectScale 0 is kept (retrieve2)
a projection without unproject is dropped (dev build)
a projection answering null drops the point
an invalid layoutCenter, or no layoutSize, falls back to the box
scaleLimit clamps the option's zoom
zoom 0 is 1
the compressed map decodes
UTF8Scale divides the decoded integers
no properties and empty coordinates are dropped
a null geometry in a compressed file throws
a geometry with no encodeOffsets is left as it is
the islands are added to a map named china only
Taiwan gets a second polygon on china only
an existing islands region is not added again
the label centre of Guangdong moves on china only
nameMap renames; duplicates stay two regions
duplicated names share one group
nameProperty picks the name
properties.cp is the centre
echartsStyle fills what the region option leaves out
show false: no drawing, a coordinate system
clip cuts to the view rect
a line takes its stroke from the fill
a map nobody registered throws in setOption
a region of lines is centred on its rect
two pending points at the same distance: the earlier is drawn (d2 > pendingPtDist)
a line's folded last point is drawn by the next moveTo
with no fill the label rect grows by strokeContainThreshold 5, not the 1 px border
borderWidth null: the path style default lineWidth 1, not the 0.5 of GeoModel
fixLineStyle keeps a line's own stroke
zoom 0 / null is 1 before the clamp: scaleLimit max 0.5 answers 0.5
a box at the aspect to atan 1e-9 is kept (350 / 0.7 would not give 500 again)
